\subsection{Instrumented background operation}   % replaces Section V's "Not instrumented"
\label{sec:instrumented}

The legs of Table~\ref{tab:cost} were run on a [handset, Android version] with
[adaptive charging off, battery saver off, app battery usage unrestricted], the handset on the
campaign mount, screen off except where stated, and no charger connected. Each leg was repeated
three times in randomised order; values are medians with the observed range in brackets.
Drain is reported as a percentage of the rated [xxxx]\,mAh capacity because OEM
\texttt{current\_now} counters are not exposed on all devices.

\begin{table*}[t]
\centering
\caption{Background-operation cost per measurement leg. ``n/m'' marks a quantity the capture did
not yield on this device; no value has been substituted for it. Bursts and epochs are counted by
the instrumented build itself, not by a system log.}
\label{tab:cost}
\small
\begin{tabular}{llrrrrrrrr}
\toprule
Leg & $n$ & Drain & vs.\ B1 & Current & Bursts/h & Results/h & Epochs/h & Compl.\ ratio & Store \\
\midrule
B1 idle baseline            & n/m & n/m & ---   & n/m & n/m & n/m & n/m & n/m & n/m \\
B2 sensing, screen off      & n/m & n/m & n/m   & n/m & n/m & n/m & n/m & n/m & n/m \\
B3 sensing, screen on       & n/m & n/m & n/m   & n/m & n/m & n/m & n/m & n/m & n/m \\
B4 two-handset transit      & n/m & n/m & n/m   & n/m & n/m & n/m & n/m & n/m & n/m \\
B5 forced Doze              & n/m & n/m & n/m   & n/m & n/m & n/m & n/m & n/m & n/m \\
B6 battery saver on         & n/m & n/m & n/m   & n/m & n/m & n/m & n/m & n/m & n/m \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabular}
\end{table*}
